dedupe_keys.name: oasis design aid for on site stormwater infiltration systems cerema and leesu

description: Oasis helps designers size on-site stormwater infiltration systems, such as permeable and vegetated source-control devices, by relating a device's design parameters to how much of the frequent rainfall volume it removes over long rainfall records, and also to flow regulation for medium and heavy rain. A machine-learning emulator (oasis-py) reproduces at low computing cost the results of a continuous hydrological model (oasis-mat), served through a Django and Vue.js web application. Cerema and the Leesu laboratory built it in the OPUR programme with support from the Seine-Normandie Water Agency; the web tool is free after creating an account, and the source code, model and user guide are available as a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (version 1.0, December 2022). Coverage is regional: the site states it cannot yet be used for rainfall conditions far from those of Île-de-France, and the user guide sets the device and catchment types it applies to. Simulation uses: sizing sustainable drainage in capacity planning and optimisation of stormwater source control and climate adaptation. Related record: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm).
inputs: Design parameters of a source-control infiltration device (permeable or vegetated) and its contributing catchment
Rainfall conditions close to those of the Île-de-France region
